title: How Showing Up Ten Minutes Early Builds a Godly Man People Can Count On
caption:
Nobody hands the important stuff to the guy who's always rushing in apologizing.

Ten minutes early sounds small. It is small. That's the point. "One who is faithful in a very little is also faithful in much." Luke 16:10.

Decide it the night before. Use the minutes on purpose. Let it be the way you honor the people waiting on you.

Try it every day this week and see who starts counting on you.

#faith #godlyman #work #discipline
